annotation.speech2: A triangle in the x y plane with vertices at the origin, at zero comma one on the y axis, and at one comma one half. The upper edge, in blue, is the line x plus two y equals two; the lower edge, in green, is the line y equals x over two; the left edge lies on the y axis. A vermillion vertical arrow at x equals zero point four runs from the very bottom of the graph to near the top, crossing the lower edge at a green point and the upper edge at a blue point. A legend box explains that the blue point is the upper bound for y and the green point is the lower bound for y.
The base of the tetrahedron: the region of integration R, shaded tan.
A vertical arrow at a fixed x, running from below the region to above it. It enters the region at the lower bound and leaves it at the upper bound.
The green intersection point with the line y equals x over 2: the lower bound for y.
The blue intersection point with the line x plus 2 y equals 2: the upper bound for y.
Legend: the blue point marks the upper bound for y and the green point marks the lower bound for y.
